events.title: Supreme Court denies stay in Uthmeier v. FL Immigrant Coalition
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States denied the application for a stay in the case of Uthmeier, Florida Attorney General, et al. v. Florida Immigrant Coalition, et al. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the lower court's decision will remain in effect while the case proceeds.
events.why_relevant: The denial of the stay affects the immediate enforcement of the lower court's ruling, impacting the parties involved.
